content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician posts is 12 September 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed across Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician posts, with 4 positions for each role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these AIIMS Bhubaneswar posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician posts at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is Email. Interested candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying to the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician positions is 35 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PWD) will be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Research Assistant?
faq.answer: For the Research Assistant post, candidates must have a Master in Public Health OR a Master of Social Work/Postgraduate in Social Sciences/Anthropology/Psychology from a recognized institution. Detailed qualifications are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for a Laboratory Technician at AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for a Laboratory Technician at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is Rs. 18,000/-. This is a contractual position, and the salary is fixed as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician recruitment. Candidates from all categories (General/OBC, SC/ST) are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician posts includes a Hybrid Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications for the interview round.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for these AIIMS Bhubaneswar posts?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Assistant and Laboratory Technician posts is Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Candidates selected for these contractual positions will be required to work at AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The official website for All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar is aiimsbhubaneswar.edu.in. Candidates can visit this website for official notifications, updates, and other relevant information regarding the recruitment.
